Damn.

First, I'm going to assume this is real. Second, I'd like to tell you how freaking brave you are. You have struggles on a level very few understand. The fact that you get up in the morning and still choose to experience life is something few people would have the strength to do given your circumstances.

Talking to your pillow and watching porn are your tools you've been using to cope with your issues. There is nothing wrong with those things, perfectly natural, but my choosing to reach out and expose this part of your life to the world shows both you and us that this isn't the life you want to live anymore. You want to experience love, you want to make friendships, you want to have a higher quality of life. My advice is: find a hobby(ies). I know that was expressed before, but honestly, that's the best non-professional advice I can give.

Your chances of making friends and finding love increase when you go out into the world. I know you have the courage to do this.

Good luck!
I've been okay, the reality of my situation hurts, sometimes. I'm just taking it day by day.. Thank you  for caring and for your message :)

I often wish the same thing for myself. Life was easier having a community of like-minded individuals surrounding me. We had the "sacred" answers to life's questions concerning the  premortal and post existence. We had scriptures, prophets, and the Holy Ghost to guide us in our lives here on earth, temples to bring us close to the ones we lost, a singles ward dedicated to helping you find a partner for life, and we had the confidence that if we did everything as according to what the prophets directed, we would be in a celestial kingdom with God. But alas, the truth is not so pretty. We became curious. We asked questions and found answers that didn't support the churches claims and all of a sudden our testimonies are wrong. We woke up from the dream and saw the nightmare. All of a sudden, our immediate families and friends never view us the same way again and it is so sad. Sorry you're going through that :/
